svg.text: TOP-DOWN ZONE PLAN · PATHS, PLACES, LEVELS, AND TERRAIN TEXTURE
Ashford depends on forest work but patrols vanish as people push
farther along old paths. The player reconnects the frontier
without being told which side caused the danger.
Ashford is a timber-walled frontier village. Forest-edge farms,
logging camps, and watch platforms form a working boundary.
Dark timber, covered porches, moss roofs, watch towers, log
yards, and small clearings. Timber, resin, mushrooms, and herbs
connect to building, woodcraft, and herblore.
Old boundary cuts and fresh logging marks support different
readings of why creatures guard certain groves.
Levels are recommended encounter / quest bands.
